title: Machine Selection + ROI + Outsourcing + Stock Tracking
brief: Wire machine auto-selection, ROI advisory for purchases, outsourcing with revenue calc, tool ROI at every selection, stock model tracking through operations.

units.title: Wire MachineSelection + ROI into pipeline
units.description: After features extracted, query MachineMatcherEngine. Rank user machines by capability+cost+availability. If no capable machine: ROIAdvisorEngine computes purchase ROI. ShopNetworkEngine + MakeVsBuyDecisionEngine for outsource option with revenue calc.

units.title: Wire ToolROIEngine at EVERY tool selection
units.description: Every tool recommendation: crib option + 3 catalog price points + ROI calculation + annual savings at user's volume.

units.title: Wire OEECalculatorEngine + CapacityPlanningEngine
units.description: Check availability before generating. Report OEE impact. Scheduling suggestion for batch.

units.title: Wire stock model tracking (StockModel + VoxelStock + CumulativeStockChain)
units.description: After each operation, update stock model. Finishing ops receive ACTUAL remaining stock. RestMachiningEngine uses stock to find uncut areas.

units.title: Wire SecondaryOpsEngine + StockAllowanceEngine
units.description: When part needs anodizing/plating/grinding: add dimensional allowance. Include secondary op cost in total.
